title: Morning / Evening Rhythm
concept: Daily anchors that inject predictability and contact — antidote to logistics-only drift.
whenToUse: Daily drift, roommate feel, after travel, or anytime connection has become transactional.
steps: Morning Reset (≤5 min): check-in + intention; phones down if possible.
Evening Landing (~10 min): how the day landed + one appreciation.
Protect windows — same windows most days.
Track Y/N for 7 days; adjust timing not intensity.

phrases.text: How are you going into today?

working: Phones down through morning hug + check-in. Evening ten minutes before mail. Drift stays small.
notWorking: Drive-by “you good?” while scrolling. Form without contact — predictability injection fails.
activity: Pick exact windows for 7 days. Log on shared note. Pair with Daily Floor.
